errors.text_span: Следва секторът "Повече от 20%", който е с дял от 23.8% и е оранжев.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the category "Повече от 20%" (More than 20%) to the orange slice with 23.8%. According to the legend and the chart, "Повече от 20%" corresponds to the purple slice with 9.5%, while the orange slice with 23.8% represents the "10-15%" category.

errors.text_span: Секторът "5-10%" е с дял от 19% и е зелен.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the category "5-10%" to the green slice with 19%. According to the legend and the chart, "5-10%" corresponds to the red slice with 14.3%, while the green slice with 19% represents the "15-20%" category.

errors.text_span: Секторът "10-15%" е с дял от 14.3% и е в червено.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the category "10-15%" to the red slice with 14.3%. According to the legend and the chart, "10-15%" corresponds to the orange slice with 23.8%, while the red slice with 14.3% represents the "5-10%" category.

errors.text_span: На последно място е секторът "15-20%" с дял от 9.5%, оцветен в светло синьо.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the category "15-20%" to the 9.5% slice and the color light blue. According to the legend and the chart, "15-20%" corresponds to the green slice with 19%. The slice with 9.5% is purple and represents the "Повече от 20%" category. There is no light blue color in the chart.

errors.text_span: която свързва цветовете със съответните проценти
errors.evidence: The description states that the legend connects colors to the corresponding percentages. In fact, the legend connects the colors to the percentage ranges (the categories), not the specific percentage values shown within the slices.

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени според размера на отговорите, като най-големият е първи.
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged by size, which is incorrect. The slices in the pie chart are not ordered in any way based on their value (e.g., clockwise or counter-clockwise by size).
